changed.meta.privacy.description: {app:title} collects no data: no accounts, no ads, no tracking, fully offline.
changed.game.b3: Nine languages. Works offline, with no account, no ads and no tracking.
changed.privacy.meta: {app:title} for iOS and Android. Last updated 21 October 2026.
changed.privacy.short: In short: {app:title} does not collect any data about you. It has no accounts, no ads, no analytics and no tracking, and it works completely offline.
changed.privacy.not.l1: It does not connect to the internet or to any server of ours.
changed.privacy.children.p: Because the app collects no personal information, it collects none from children either.
changed.support.meta: {app:title} for iOS and Android. Last updated 21 October 2026.
changed.support.q5.a: No. It works offline and collects no data. See the Privacy Policy.
changed.privacy.stores.p1: The app keeps a few things on your device only, so the game remembers them next time:
changed.privacy.stores.p2: This information never leaves your device. Lumoxia cannot see it. You can erase the statistics at any time with “{app:statsReset}” in the Stats panel, and deleting the app removes everything.
changed.privacy.links.p: The Rules panel has links to other websites (for example the Lumoxia pages, a history video and the credits for the sound tools) and to these pages. When you tap one, your browser opens it. That website then deals with you under its own privacy policy, which Lumoxia does not control.
